primitives.note: Gleaming Quill projectile deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, on cooldown; cooldown starts only once the projectile vanishes (hits or reaches max range), not on cast.
Grand Entrance dashes then deals magic damage to nearby enemies after a short delay upon arrival; cooldown starts on cast.
The Quickness has a 0.5s cast time during which Grand Entrance is disabled (though it can be buffered); Q and E remain castable.
The Quickness deals magic damage on collision with an enemy; against a single dummy this fires at most once per cast.
R's damage requires Rakan to physically touch the target while sprinting rather than being a targeted-cast; the dummy fight must assume he collides with the stationary dummy once.

Battle Dance can be recast within 5s at no extra cost, mimicking the first cast's shield+dash; both casts count as ability activations for on-cast/on-cast-trigger item effects even though the ability itself deals no damage.

Passive's periodic self-shield (P), Gleaming Quill's self/ally heal-on-mark-complete (Q), and Battle Dance's shield (E) change damage taken/effective HP only and are never read by the damage-dealt fight.

needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant behavior (Q, W, R's on-collision hit, R's brief cast-time lock, E's recast structure, and the purely defensive heals/shields) is expressible with plain-cast, charge-or-channel, positional-assumption, recast-or-multipart, and defensive-only from the closed list; no bespoke mechanic is required.

Treat Q's cooldown as starting on cast for simplicity, ignoring the small travel-time discrepancy

proposal: Open with W (Grand Entrance), dashing onto/near the dummy to land its magic damage and knock-up (knock-up ignored) as early as possible.
Follow immediately with Q (Gleaming Quill) once its 0.25s cast time completes, since it has the shortest cooldown and should be recast as often as possible.

Cast R (The Quickness) early in the fight to secure its one guaranteed collision hit on the dummy and its up-front burst, since its cooldown (130-90s) means it will not be available again within the 15s window.
Weave basic attacks in whenever no ability is on cooldown or in cast time.
Recast Q and W on cooldown for the remainder of the 15 seconds (accounting for Q's cooldown starting after projectile travel), continuing basic attacks between casts.
Skip or deprioritize E in the damage fight unless self-targeting is confirmed useful, since it deals no damage to the dummy.
questions: Should R be cast first (to lock in its one-time collision damage before its long cooldown makes it irrelevant) or last (to avoid its 0.5s cast time delaying other casts), given CC/mobility effects are otherwise ignored?
Is casting E at all worthwhile in the damage fight, given it deals no damage and its self-targeting behavior is unsettled?
Should Q be cast at maximum range (longer travel, larger cooldown-start delay) or point-blank (minimizing the vanish-triggered cooldown delay) to maximize total casts in 15 seconds?
